jobs.title: Junior Software Developer - System Integration Labs (North Shore)
jobs.description:
Our engineers are the technical visionaries behind our innovative solutions. Globally recognized for delivering cutting-edge systems, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate across functions, and lead advancements that shape our industry. Supported by a culture of flexibility, growth, and innovation, join us to create a lasting legacy in safety and simulation.  

**Description**

As a Software Developer, you will develop real-time simulation software used in military aircraft system integration laboratories. These engineering simulators reproduce aircraft systems and functions so that teams can test and validate software before it is installed on an aircraft. The emphasis is on aircraft controls and system behaviour rather than visual simulation.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop object-oriented software components, primarily in C++, to reproduce aircraft behaviour in real time.

* Simulate the digital and analog signals associated with the aircraft’s avionics systems.

* Participate in all phases of software development, including problem analysis, requirements definition, design, implementation, informal testing, troubleshooting, and integration.

* Support the software’s user community.

* Work with several simulation models used for a single aircraft and adapt your approach to different systems and technical requirements.

* Collaborate within a multidisciplinary team of approximately 10 employees, including a subgroup of approximately four employees that works closely with other subgroups.

* Work autonomously while collaborating regularly with software, systems, avionics, and other engineering groups.

Valid driver’s license, or ability to commute to the Mirabel offices  

  

**This is a full-time, Monday-Friday hybrid working arrangement, with an expected presence of two to three days per week at the Mirabel office and occasional work from the Saint-Laurent office. Core working hours are from 9:30AM – 3:30PM.**

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer science.

* Up to three years of software development experience.

* Knowledge of C++ and C#.

* Ability to learn aircraft systems, simulation models, and new technical concepts quickly.

* Ability to work autonomously, manage changing technical requirements, and demonstrate flexibility across multiple simulation models.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

* Ability to communicate orally and in writing about technical subjects in English or French.

* Ability to meet the requirements of Canada’s Controlled Goods Program and, in certain cases, applicable International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements.

Eligibility to obtain and maintain Government of Canada Reliability Status and a Level II Secret security clearance.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Rust or Java.

* Knowledge of FPGA development or technologies.

* Knowledge of aeronautics, avionics, or aircraft systems.

* Experience developing real-time simulation software.

Demonstrated interest in aviation.  

  

**Benefits**

We’ve designed flexible policies to promote well-being and growth, based on role-specific eligibility and requirements:

* Hybrid work arrangement combining office-based and remote work.

* Flexible working hours.

* Career development and internal mobility opportunities within CAE.

* Mentoring and access to the CAE Career Track program.

* Collaborative and positive work environment.

* Opportunity to be part of a small professional community within a large organization.

* Work-life balance.

* Comprehensive CAE benefits program, including health insurance, an employee stock purchase plan, a pension plan, and a physical activity program.

**About CAE**
=============

*At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success.*

**Position Type**
=================

Regular

**Equal Opportunity & Accommodations**
======================================

*CAE is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, nationality, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, veteran status, age, or other characteristics protected by law. We encourage applicants who may not meet every qualification to apply. Reasonable accommodations are available—contact your recruiter or email* *CAECarrieres-Careers@cae.com* *if needed.*

**Data Privacy**
================

Privacy Statement | CAE

*As part of our process, we may use AI‑supported tools to help review applications, with human decision‑making at every step. CAE thanks all applicants for their interest. However, only those whose background and experience match the requirements of the role will be contacted.*

jobs.title: Test Automation Analyst
jobs.description:
**We are:**

The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) are the engine for reinvention in our clients’ transformation journey. Powered by more than 255,000 people across 24 countries, ATCs provide our clients with seamless access to industry insights and innovative technology solutions.

**Stronger together!**

The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) make a tremendous impact in solving our clients’ business problems by leveraging innovation, intelligence, industry insights, new IT, and new technology skills. With the global environment changing at a faster pace, our clients are facing unprecedented challenges, and they need us more than ever before. As a Network, ATCs are positioned to unlock greater opportunities and exponential value for our clients.

**The value for our clients and our people:**

For our clients, the Network provides the strength of our geographic diversity, greater resilience, and seamless access to the deepest industry knowledge, the latest in Gen AI solutions, and tech expertise from around the world.

For our people, it brings an opportunity to shape truly boundaryless career paths in a highly collaborative team of experts where they can learn from each other and solve the world’s most complex client challenges.

**You Are**

A Technology Analyst/Associate with a passion for quality engineering, automation, and modern software development. You have experience through academic projects, internships, co-op placements, or professional experience using programming languages such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Python, or C#, and are eager to grow your expertise in test automation and software engineering.

You enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in Agile environments. You leverage GenAI tools to improve productivity, streamline testing activities, and support the delivery of high-quality technology solutions.

**The Work**

As part of a cross-functional Agile delivery team, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and support of modern web and cloud-native applications. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will help deliver high-quality solutions through automation, software development, and quality engineering best practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the development, execution, and maintenance of automated test scripts using TypeScript and modern automation tools such as Playwright, Selenium, or WebdriverIO.
* Execute functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing activities for enterprise applications.
* Collaborate with developers, testers, and product teams to understand requirements, develop test cases, and validate application functionality.
* Assist in the creation and enhancement of reusable automation components and test assets.
* Support the integration of automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve software quality and release readiness.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, and retrospectives.
* Leverage GenAI tools to support test case creation, code generation, documentation, troubleshooting, and productivity improvements.
* Contribute to the testing of cloud-native and distributed applications.
* Perform API validation, test data verification, and defect analysis to ensure application quality.
* Document test results, defects, risks, and remediation recommendations.
* Support production validation, post-release testing, and ongoing quality assurance activities.
* Follow established engineering, security, accessibility, and compliance standards.
* Continuously grow technical capabilities through training, certifications, mentorship, and project-based learning.
* **This role is located in one of the following location (Mississauga/ Montreal) and will require on-site 3 days per week.**

  

**Here's What You'll Need**

* Minium 2 years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, software development
* Experience through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional experience using one or more programming languages such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Python, or C#.
* Exposure to automated testing concepts and tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, WebdriverIO, or similar frameworks.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), software testing lifecycle (STLC), Agile delivery methodologies, and DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with source control and collaborative development tools such as Git.
* Basic knowledge of API testing, test automation principles, and quality engineering best practices.
* Exposure to cloud technologies, CI/CD concepts, and modern software delivery practices.
* Awareness of GenAI tools and technologies and an interest in applying them to software development, testing, productivity, and automation activities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
* Demonstrated curiosity, willingness to learn, and passion for technology and innovation.
* Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced, client-focused, and Agile delivery environment.
* Bachelor’s degree or completion of a college program in a related discipline
* Must be eligible to obtain and maintain Reliability Clearance.
* English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with English-speaking stakeholders across Canada. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English-speaking stakeholders, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, WebdriverIO, or other modern automation tools.
* Exposure to API testing tools such as Postman, Insomnia, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience working with GitHub, Azure DevOp

jobs.title: Junior Full-Stack Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Junior Full-Stack Software Developer**

**About Effortless Admin**  
  
Benefits administration is complicated, and when it goes wrong, real people miss coverage they're counting on. Effortless Admin builds the platform that keeps it running smoothly for employers across Canada. We're a small team that moves fast. The code you write ships to real clients, and you'll see the difference it makes.  
  
**The role**  
**Full-time - On-site in Edmonton, AB**  
  
As a Junior Full-Stack Developer, you'll build features across our platform using React on the front end and C#/.NET on the back end. You'll work side by side with senior developers who will review your code, pair with you, and help you grow quickly.  
  
**Why you'll like working here**  
  
We're a small team, and that's a big part of what makes this role different. You'll work closely with senior developers every day, with real pairing, quick answers when you're stuck, and direct feedback on your code.  
Because we're small and move quickly, good ideas don't sit in a backlog for months. The features you build will ship to real clients, and you'll see the impact of your work early and often.  
  
**How we're working with AI**  
  
We're actively bringing AI into how we work, using it to help us write, review, and test code, and exploring where it can make our platform better for clients.  
We don't have it all figured out, and that's the point. We're learning and experimenting as a team, and we want developers who are curious about it and will help us find where it makes a real difference. You don't need to be an expert, just interested.  
  
**What you'll do**

* Build responsive, easy-to-use interfaces with React and modern JavaScript
* Develop and maintain C#/.NET services that power our core platform
* Design and connect RESTful APIs between the front end and back end
* Work with SQL Server to store and manage application data
* Build reusable components and keep the app fast
* Write clean, well-tested code and take part in code reviews
* Work with our UX designers to turn designs into intuitive experiences
* Experiment with AI tools that help us build better and faster

  

**Who we're looking for**  
You think critically about code, including your own. You ask whether something will be easy to maintain, not just whether it works today, and you can explain your reasoning. You're also open to changing your mind as you learn, because what counts as good code keeps evolving.  
You're adaptable. You're comfortable picking up new tools, switching between front-end and back-end work, and learning as you go. On a small team things change quickly, and that's part of the fun.  
You also care about the people using what you build. You notice when a screen is confusing or a workflow takes one click too many, and you want to fix it. Our users are HR teams and employees dealing with their benefits, and making that experience feel effortless matters to us.

**What you'll bring**  
  
**Must have**

* 1–2 years of hands-on development experience (co-op and internship work counts)
* Solid experience with JavaScript and React
* Working knowledge of C# and .NET
* A good grasp of object-oriented programming
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
* Comfort with SQL and relational databases
* Experience with Git

**Nice to have**

* A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Experience with React libraries like Redux or React Query
* A good understanding of CSS
* Experience on an agile team, using tools like Asana or Jira
* Hands-on experience with AI coding tools

**What we offer**

* Competitive pay and a strong benefits package (we are a benefits company, after all)
* Daily mentorship, pairing, and code reviews with senior developers
* A clear path to intermediate and senior roles
* A modern stack and room to try new tools, including AI
* A team that respects work-life balance
* An on-site gym and swimming pool in our building

  

**How to apply**  
  
Send us your resume and a short note about why this role interests you. If you have a GitHub profile or projects you're proud of, include the links. We'd love to see what you've built.

Effortless Admin is committed to building diverse teams and an inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Jr. Full Stack Developer - Invitation Project
jobs.description:
Jr. Full Stack Developer - Invitation Project

**THE PROJECT**
===============

We are building a subscription-based Evangelism platform to enable ordinary Christians to share their faith.

**THE POSITION**
================

We are seeking a motivated Junior Full-Stack Developer to join our team and help build the core infrastructure of our hybrid evangelism app. You will work closely with senior engineers to design, develop, and maintain the platform's front and back end, focusing on writing clean TypeScript/Node.js code and learning best practices for scalability.

This role is perfect for a candidate who is passionate about technology, eager to learn hybrid mobile development (React Native / Flutter), and curious about relational databases (PostgreSQL). You will collaborate in a supportive environment to help deliver an engaging user experience worldwide.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
====================

* Collaborate with senior developers to build and scale a hybrid mobile application.
* Help manage relational SQL databases and learn data modelling techniques.
* Support the development of backend REST and GraphQL APIs using Node.js, Express, and TypeScript.
* Help implement new frontend features and UI components for mobile and web.
* Ensure smooth authentication using Firebase Auth / Auth0 / Supabase.
* Integrate payment processing with Stripe, PayPal, or Paddle for subscriptions.
* Implement cloud storage solutions (AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Cloudflare R2).
* Develop and maintain push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) / OneSignal.
* Optimize the application's performance and security.
* Collaborate with designers, content managers, and other stakeholders.
* Write clean, maintainable code and follow software development best practices.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS REQUIRED**
======================================

* Must be a dedicated Christian and willing to sign a statement of faith
* Willingness to sign a non-disclosure, non-compete agreement.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar experience.
* Basic experience with or a strong desire to learn full-stack development.
* Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as React, React Native, or Flutter, alongside HTML5/CSS3 and TypeScript.
* Foundational knowledge of backend programming and API concepts.
* Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and ORMs such as Prisma or TypeORM.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
* Knowledge of authentication & security protocols (OAuth, JWT, Firebase Auth, or Auth0).
* Experience with payment gateway integration (Stripe, PayPal, Paddle, etc.).
* Understanding of Git version control and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Docker) for efficient deployment.
* Strong willingness to learn, adapt, and receive constructive feedback.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Passion for evangelism and using technology to spread the Gospel.

**BENEFITS**
============

* Flexible working hours and remote work options.
* Opportunity to be part of a mission-driven organization.
* A collaborative and supportive team environment.
* The chance to work on cutting-edge technology for evangelism.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Agentic AI
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a talented and driven Software Engineer to join our AI initiatives team, focusing heavily on developing sophisticated agentic solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing autonomous systems that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to reason, plan, and execute complex workflows. A deep understanding of context engineering, tool usage, and LLM orchestration is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and deploy agentic workflows that can autonomously solve multi-step problems using tools and APIs.
* Perform advanced context engineering to optimize LLM prompts, manage context windows efficiently, and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Integrate LLMs with external systems, databases, and third-party APIs to enable agentic actions.
* Develop evaluation frameworks to monitor agent performance, reduce hallucinations, and ensure safe and predictable behavior in production environments.
* Collaborate with product and data teams to identify opportunities for AI-driven automation and intelligent feature development.

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Python and experience with backend framework development.
* Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen).
* Strong background in context engineering, prompt optimization, and working with top-tier LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic).
* Experience building and scaling RAG architectures using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus).
* Solid understanding of system design principles, especially for distributed and asynchronous systems.

Pay: $185,000.00-$225,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental care
* Paid time off
* RRSP match
* Stock options

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Toronto, ON (Toronto District)

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**SEGULA Technologies Canada** fait partie d’un groupe d’ingénierie international reconnu pour son expertise et son innovation dans les secteurs automobile, aéronautique, énergie, ferroviaire, naval, télécoms et life sciences. Présents dans plus de 30 pays avec 15 000 talents, nous mettons notre savoir-faire au service de projets d’envergure, de la conception jusqu’à l’industrialisation. Au Canada, nos équipes du Québec et de l’Ontario collaborent avec des clients majeurs et évoluent dans un environnement technique, rigoureux et stimulant, où chaque talent peut contribuer, apprendre et se développer.

Nous recrutons un(e) stagiaire ingénieur ou Data Analyst pour renforcer l’équipe RH dans la structuration, l’analyse et l’automatisation de ses données. Au cœur de la transformation data de la fonction RH, tu contribueras à construire des outils de pilotage fiables et utiles à la décision, à améliorer la qualité des données et des processus, et à industrialiser des workflows à forte valeur ajoutée.

**Missions principales**

* **Business Intelligence & Power BI** – Développer, maintenir et optimiser des tableaux de bord Power BI pour le suivi des KPI RH : recrutement, activité, performance, finances, forecasting, etc.
* **Modélisation & DAX** – Construire des modèles de données robustes, définir les indicateurs métier, développer les mesures DAX et optimiser la lisibilité, la performance et l’expérience utilisateur des rapports.
* **Data preparation & qualité** – Collecter, rapprocher, transformer et fiabiliser des données issues de plusieurs systèmes (SIRH, ATS, ERP, fichiers Excel/Google Sheets, exports métiers, etc.) à l’aide notamment de Power Query et de contrôles de cohérence.
* **Automatisation** – Identifier les tâches répétitives et concevoir des automatisations adaptées avec Power Automate, Google Apps Script ou des outils équivalents afin de réduire les opérations manuelles.
* **Industrialisation des flux** – Participer à la mise en place de flux de données et de processus plus fiables : imports, synchronisations, contrôles, gestion des doublons, suivi des erreurs et réduction des manipulations manuelles.
* **Analyse & benchmarking** – Réaliser des analyses ad hoc : benchmarks salariaux, analyses de coûts, comparaisons marché/internes, suivi de ramp-up, analyses de conversion et identification de tendances ou de points de blocage.
* **Amélioration continue** – Identifier les leviers d’amélioration de la qualité des données et des processus RH et proposer des solutions pragmatiques et adaptées aux besoins opérationnels.
* **Documentation & communication** – Produire une documentation claire et maintenable (définitions de KPI, mapping de données, logique DAX, procédures et workflows) et vulgariser les résultats auprès d’interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques.

  
  

### **Profil**

* **1 à 3 années d’expérience professionnelle** en Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science ou dans un rôle similaire.
* Diplôme universitaire en **génie, informatique, data science, statistique, mathématiques, intelligence d’affaires** ou domaine connexe.
* Bonne maîtrise de **Power BI**, avec une expérience pratique de **Power Query, de la modélisation de données et de DAX**.
* Bonne maîtrise de **SQL** et d’**Excel avancé**.
* Expérience dans la manipulation, le nettoyage et l’analyse de données provenant de **sources multiples et hétérogènes**.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Agentic AI
new_jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a talented and driven Software Engineer to join our AI initiatives team, focusing heavily on developing sophisticated agentic solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing autonomous systems that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to reason, plan, and execute complex workflows. A deep understanding of context engineering, tool usage, and LLM orchestration is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and deploy agentic workflows that can autonomously solve multi-step problems using tools and APIs.
* Perform advanced context engineering to optimize LLM prompts, manage context windows efficiently, and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Integrate LLMs with external systems, databases, and third-party APIs to enable agentic actions.
* Develop evaluation frameworks to monitor agent performance, reduce hallucinations, and ensure safe and predictable behavior in production environments.
* Collaborate with product and data teams to identify opportunities for AI-driven automation and intelligent feature development.

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Python and experience with backend framework development.
* Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen).
* Strong background in context engineering, prompt optimization, and working with top-tier LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic).
* Experience building and scaling RAG architectures using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus).
* Solid understanding of system design principles, especially for distributed and asynchronous systems.

Pay: $185,000.00-$225,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental care
* Paid time off
* RRSP match
* Stock options

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Toronto, ON (Toronto District)

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**SEGULA Technologies Canada** fait partie d’un groupe d’ingénierie international reconnu pour son expertise et son innovation dans les secteurs automobile, aéronautique, énergie, ferroviaire, naval, télécoms et life sciences. Présents dans plus de 30 pays avec 15 000 talents, nous mettons notre savoir-faire au service de projets d’envergure, de la conception jusqu’à l’industrialisation. Au Canada, nos équipes du Québec et de l’Ontario collaborent avec des clients majeurs et évoluent dans un environnement technique, rigoureux et stimulant, où chaque talent peut contribuer, apprendre et se développer.

Nous recrutons un(e) stagiaire ingénieur ou Data Analyst pour renforcer l’équipe RH dans la structuration, l’analyse et l’automatisation de ses données. Au cœur de la transformation data de la fonction RH, tu contribueras à construire des outils de pilotage fiables et utiles à la décision, à améliorer la qualité des données et des processus, et à industrialiser des workflows à forte valeur ajoutée.

**Missions principales**

* **Business Intelligence & Power BI** – Développer, maintenir et optimiser des tableaux de bord Power BI pour le suivi des KPI RH : recrutement, activité, performance, finances, forecasting, etc.
* **Modélisation & DAX** – Construire des modèles de données robustes, définir les indicateurs métier, développer les mesures DAX et optimiser la lisibilité, la performance et l’expérience utilisateur des rapports.
* **Data preparation & qualité** – Collecter, rapprocher, transformer et fiabiliser des données issues de plusieurs systèmes (SIRH, ATS, ERP, fichiers Excel/Google Sheets, exports métiers, etc.) à l’aide notamment de Power Query et de contrôles de cohérence.
* **Automatisation** – Identifier les tâches répétitives et concevoir des automatisations adaptées avec Power Automate, Google Apps Script ou des outils équivalents afin de réduire les opérations manuelles.
* **Industrialisation des flux** – Participer à la mise en place de flux de données et de processus plus fiables : imports, synchronisations, contrôles, gestion des doublons, suivi des erreurs et réduction des manipulations manuelles.
* **Analyse & benchmarking** – Réaliser des analyses ad hoc : benchmarks salariaux, analyses de coûts, comparaisons marché/internes, suivi de ramp-up, analyses de conversion et identification de tendances ou de points de blocage.
* **Amélioration continue** – Identifier les leviers d’amélioration de la qualité des données et des processus RH et proposer des solutions pragmatiques et adaptées aux besoins opérationnels.
* **Documentation & communication** – Produire une documentation claire et maintenable (définitions de KPI, mapping de données, logique DAX, procédures et workflows) et vulgariser les résultats auprès d’interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques.

  
  

### **Profil**

* **1 à 3 années d’expérience professionnelle** en Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science ou dans un rôle similaire.
* Diplôme universitaire en **génie, informatique, data science, statistique, mathématiques, intelligence d’affaires** ou domaine connexe.
* Bonne maîtrise de **Power BI**, avec une expérience pratique de **Power Query, de la modélisation de données et de DAX**.
* Bonne maîtrise de **SQL** et d’**Excel avancé**.
* Expérience dans la manipulation, le nettoyage et l’analyse de données provenant de **sources multiples et hétérogènes**.
* Capacité à développer des **dashboards, KPI et rapports** permettant de transformer les données en informations utiles à la prise de décision.
* Une expérience avec des outils d’**automatisation** tels que Power Automate, Google Apps Script ou équivalent constitue un atout.
* Rigueur, autonomie, esprit analytique et capacité à résoudre des problèmes.
* Capacité à communiquer clairement les résultats d’analyses auprès d’interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques.
* Intérêt pour les **systèmes RH, People Analytics** et l’utilisation de la donnée pour améliorer le pilotage opérationnel.
* Intérêt marqué pour l’**IA générative** et ses applications concrètes en entreprise.
